subject: 2025 State of the City Address
overview: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn, City Council President Zac Bears, and School Committee Vice Chair Jenny Graham delivered the 2025 State of the City Address, reviewing progress on school funding, infrastructure, and governance. The officials highlighted the impacts of recently approved override votes on city services and the advancement of the Medford High School building project.

items.title: Poetry Reading
items.summary: Poet Laureate Vijaya Sundaram recited an original poem focused on community unity, diversity, and the city's natural environment.

items.title: School Committee Update
items.summary: Jenny Graham reported on the allocation of $7 million in override funding, the appointment of an interim superintendent, and the progression of the high school building project into the MSBA feasibility phase.

items.title: City Council Update
items.summary: Zac Bears highlighted the council's two-year governing plan, the passage of nine new ordinances, and ongoing efforts to modernize the city's charter and zoning regulations.

items.title: Mayor's State of the City Address
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn outlined major initiatives including the redevelopment of Medford Square, increased staffing for public safety and the DPW, and the receipt of significant grants for sustainability and climate resilience.
